description: This file defines the EmployeeEducationService class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It provides methods to access and set an EmployeeEducationDao object, which manages database operations related to employee education data.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling employee education data interactions, primarily via EmployeeEducationDao.

methods.name: getEmployeeEducationDao
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of EmployeeEducationDao, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: setEmployeeEducationDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeEducationDao instance used by this service.
